expectedServiceTracesFromSourceOnly.oneBrowserModalOpenAndOneRaf: With one mounted open, one rAF callback, matching active name and one ready local-port instance: two getStats calls, one listLibraries call, two recordLocalLensStats replies followed by updateLensStatus({}), one original drop-handler wiring. At local module seam this normally means three openLocalLens calls; at real worker boundary init memoization is a different trace. Freeze actual trace before asserting counts.
expectedServiceTracesFromSourceOnly.statusToggle: saveLensConfig({enabled}) then only chip getters/replacement. No getLocalLens/list/getStats, no whole-panel replacement; input identity/value/caret/focus unchanged.
expectedServiceTracesFromSourceOnly.statsSuccess: getStats response -> recordLocalLensStats(s) -> updateLensStatus({}) -> if captured stats absent return; otherwise original stats/list publication and idempotent drop wiring.
expectedServiceTracesFromSourceOnly.libraryPicker: list -> active lookup -> if active name differs saveLensConfig({name}) + updateLensStatusChip, even if no select -> if select exists exact empty/options; error option only and no name write.
expectedServiceTracesFromSourceOnly.libraryActivate: guard falsy ID -> backend-gated activate -> clearLensCache -> notification -> loadLibraryPicker -> conditional stats refresh -> chip update; rejected operation uses original notification and no successful continuation.
expectedServiceTracesFromSourceOnly.libraryCreate: Preparing busy before getLocalLens; busy false before actual form/plain prompt; cancel yields no create/cache/list/stats. Accepted pick: Creating busy -> backend check/local service -> createLibrary(name,model) -> activateLibrary(created.id) -> cache clear/notification -> list/name sync -> conditional stats -> chip -> finally idle.
expectedServiceTracesFromSourceOnly.libraryRename: list active -> real prompt -> empty/unchanged next returns; rename -> cache clear -> notification -> picker -> chip; no stats refresh in original rename handler.
expectedServiceTracesFromSourceOnly.libraryDelete: real confirmation -> list -> guard absent active -> delete -> cache clear -> remaining-dependent notification -> picker -> conditional stats -> chip.
expectedServiceTracesFromSourceOnly.ingest: Snapshot files before awaits; busy rejection; show pill/reset stop flag -> parallel local module/open + parser -> per-file extraction -> stop/empty gates -> load model -> subscribe -> ingest -> original progress/messages/done branches/cache/notification -> finally flags false + unsubscribe + 3000ms timer + stats refresh.

workerProtocolRecipe.required: Real lens-local module with fake Worker only; requests/replies valid current protocol, recorded FIFO; ready complete model/embedder/library payload; stats_result complete fields; saving progress -> original client commit_ingest -> then ingest_done.
workerProtocolRecipe.queueLimits: Real send queue serializes replies. Delay one legitimate inflight reply to assess DOM/backend staleness. Never emit a reverse/wrong-type response to the current inflight request as a fabricated concurrency acceptance case.
workerProtocolRecipe.additionalWireStats: ingest does stats after ingest_done before returning; deleteDocument does stats after delete_done; final UI hydration causes another stats request. Distinguish wire count from UI getStats count.
workerProtocolRecipe.persistenceLimit: Fake Worker side effects and localStorage cached count are synthetic protocol evidence, not actual worker IndexedDB/model persistence.
